    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">[全流程详细教程]Docker部署ClawBot, 使用GLM4.7, 接入TG Bot实现私人助理. 解决Docker Openclaw Permission Denied问题</span>
    

</a>

<h1 id="deploy">Deploy</h1>
<h2 id="clone-repo">Clone Repo</h2>
<p>Github Openclaw Repo: <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">git clone https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git
</code></pre>
<h2 id="修改setupsh脚本">修改Setup.sh脚本</h2>
<p>如果不修改脚本, 会出现openclaw Permission Denied的情况.</p>
<blockquote>
<p>详细参考 <code>Debug</code> 章节的 <code>## 无法配对机器人</code>的内容</p>
</blockquote>
<p>主要是要进行 <code>chown -R 1000:1000 "$OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR"</code> 的操作</p>
<h2 id="deploy-with-sh-script">Deploy With Sh Script</h2>
<p>使用脚本<code>./docker-setup.sh</code></p>
<p>该脚本会自动完成：</p>
<ol>
<li>构建 Docker 镜像(<code>IMAGE_NAME="${OPENCLAW_IMAGE:-openclaw:local}"</code>)</li>
<li>运行交互式 onboarding 向导</li>
<li>生成 Gateway Token 并写入 .env</li>
<li>启动网关服务</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-shell">./docker-setup.sh
</code></pre>
<p>如果你好奇官方脚本做了什么, 可以点击查看一下内容:</p>
<details>
<summary>docker-compose.yaml文件做了什么</summary>
<p>docker-compose.yml 定义了两个服务：</p>
<p>openclaw-gateway (网关服务)</p>
<ul>
<li>端口: 18789 (网关), 18790 (桥接)</li>
<li>绑定: 默认 lan (局域网可访问)</li>
<li>重启策略: unless-stopped</li>
<li>持久化: 配置目录和工作空间挂载到主机</li>
</ul>
<p>openclaw-cli (CLI 服务)</p>
<ul>
<li>交互式终端 (tty: true, stdin_open: true)</li>
<li>用于执行命令、配置通道、运行 onboarding</li>
</ul>
</details>
<h2 id="check-docker-image">Check Docker Image</h2>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3573053/202602/3573053-20260207181552025-688972341.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>整个Image大小: 4.+GB</p>
</blockquote>

<h3 id="完成onboard配置">完成Onboard配置</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3573053/202602/3573053-20260207183018599-777339214.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="web-dashboard配置">Web Dashboard配置</h2>
<p>我中途不小心kill了Docker, 我使用<code>docker compose up -d openclaw-gateway</code>指令恢复</p>
<blockquote>
<p>配置都存放在<code>~/.openclaw/</code>, 所以没事</p>
</blockquote>
<details>
<summary>检查Token(这一步不需要, URL中携带了Token)</summary>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3573053/202602/3573053-20260207184044185-1718459786.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>使用<code>cat ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json | grep token</code>找到你需要在Web上配置的Token</p>
</blockquote>
</details>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3573053/202602/3573053-20260207184624054-412913168.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>修改配置文件: <code>vim ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json</code></p>
<p>添加:</p>
<pre><code>    "controlUi": {
      "enabled": true,
      "allowInsecureAuth": true
    },
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3573053/202602/3573053-20260207184601538-1244152700.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>修改完之后不需要重启服务, 就可以连接成功</p>
<h1 id="接入bot">接入Bot</h1>
<h2 id="tg-bot">TG Bot</h2>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3573053/202602/3573053-20260207180719443-1183558820.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>使用 BotFather 创建Bot</p>
</blockquote>
<p>文档: <a href="https://core.telegram.org/bots" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://core.telegram.org/bots</a></p>
<pre><code>/newbot - create a new bot
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>使用 <code>\newbot</code> 指令</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code>Alright, a new bot. How are we going to call it? Please choose a name for your bot.
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>然后会提出输入Bot的名字.<br>
Bot名字规范: Good. Now let's choose a username for your bot. It must end in <code>bot</code>. Like this, for example: TetrisBot or tetris_bot.</p>
</blockquote>
<p>输入了预期的Bot名字之后, <strong>会给你Bot的认证Token</strong><br>
添加:</p>
<h2 id="setup-clawbot">Setup ClawBot</h2>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3573053/202602/3573053-20260207182613975-1934782443.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>配置Token</p>
<h2 id="pair-tg-bot">Pair TG Bot</h2>
<pre><code>openclaw pairing approve telegram &lt;code&gt;
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>需要在容器内部执行, 这里存在一个坑</p>
</blockquote>
<p>我使用 <code>docker compose up openclaw-cli pairing approve telegram &lt;Code&gt;</code> 指令解决了问题</p>
<h1 id="debug">Debug</h1>
<h2 id="tg-bot无法回复">TG Bot无法回复</h2>
<p>被墙了</p>
<blockquote>
<p>ClawBot吃Env配置代理, 但是在容器中, 我一直没有配起来</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">  openclaw-gateway:
    image: ${OPENCLAW_IMAGE:-openclaw:local}
    network_mode: "host"
    environment:
      HOME: /home/node
      TERM: xterm-256color
      OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN: ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN}
      CLAUDE_AI_SESSION_KEY: ${CLAUDE_AI_SESSION_KEY}
      CLAUDE_WEB_SESSION_KEY: ${CLAUDE_WEB_SESSION_KEY}
      CLAUDE_WEB_COOKIE: ${CLAUDE_WEB_COOKIE}
      # 代理配置：现在可以直接用 127.0.0.1 了
      http_proxy: http://127.0.0.1:20171
      https_proxy: http://127.0.0.1:20171
      all_proxy: socks5h://127.0.0.1:20170
      HTTP_PROXY: http://127.0.0.1:20171
      HTTPS_PROXY: http://127.0.0.1:20171
      ALL_PROXY: socks5h://127.0.0.1:20170
      no_proxy: localhost,127.0.0.1
      NO_PROXY: localhost,127.0.0.1
</code></pre>
<h2 id="无法配对机器人">无法配对机器人</h2>
<p>参考: <a href="https://openclaw-ai.org/guides/fix-openclaw-docker-eacces-permission-denied" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://openclaw-ai.org/guides/fix-openclaw-docker-eacces-permission-denied</a></p>
<p>容器内的 node 用户（UID 1000）没有权限读写宿主机挂载进去的文件夹（通常是因为宿主机文件夹属于 root 或其他用户）.<br>
出现了 <code>openclaw: Permission denied</code></p>
<p>fast way:<br>
chown -R 1000:1000 "$HOME/.openclaw"</p>
<p>or add in docker-setup.sh:</p>
<h1 id="after-lines">after lines:</h1>
<p>mkdir -p "$OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR"<br>
mkdir -p "$OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR"</p>
<p>chown -R 1000:1000 "$OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR"</p>
<pre><code>diff --git a/docker-setup.sh b/docker-setup.sh
index 89b8346a3..089a52b4e 100755
--- a/docker-setup.sh
+++ b/docker-setup.sh
@@ -27,6 +27,8 @@ OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR="${OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR:-$HOME/.openclaw/workspace}"
 mkdir -p "$OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR"
 mkdir -p "$OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR"

+chown -R 1000:1000 "$OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR"
+
 export OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR
 export OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR
 export OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT="${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT:-18789}"
</code></pre>
